title: Remitly Makes Sending Money as Easy as Sending a Text
summary: Send with Link lets Remitly customers send money abroad with one text — no bank details, forms, or waiting.
body_markdown:
“Sending money around the world shouldn’t feel like homework,” said Sebastian Gunningham, CEO of Remitly. “You should be able to send it the way you’d send a text — because now you can with Remitly.”


The result: sending money, reduced to the only two things that ever mattered — who, and how much.


Ready to send? Download the Remitly app today.


*Send with Text is available today to select customers in the US, Canada, and Australia, and will roll out to all customers in the coming weeks.*
